description_en: Queries the database accounts of a cluster

kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-accounts --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --account-name test_accout --engine Clickhouse --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccounts
